facility_roles.quote: GADMC is currently building inside the LNGS Hall-C DarkSide-20k, a two-phase LAr detector with a 50 tonnes active volume, 1000 times more than its predecessor DarkSide-50

intervals.label: construction
intervals.note: "2024" is when arXiv:2402.07566 (submitted Feb 2024) confirms construction was already under way ("has entered the construction phase"); used as a lower-bound start since no source consulted gives the true construction-start date. Still described as "currently under construction" on the LNGS facility page checked 2026-09-17. Planned data-taking start: "late 2026" per arXiv:2402.07566 or "2027" per the LNGS page; both are recorded in this note rather than as an interval.
intervals.quote: Currently, the experiment has entered the construction phase and the external cryostat is being put in place at Laboratori Nazionali del Gran Sasso (LNGS), Italy.

quantity.quote: DarkSide-20k, a two-phase LAr detector with a 50 tonnes active volume, 1000 times more than its predecessor DarkSide-50

lineage.note: The report says GADMC 'recently proposed' DarkSide-LowMass as a parallel and complementary project to DarkSide-20k. Relation stored on the lexicographically smaller id.
lineage.quote: detector as a parallel and complementary project to DS20k: a 1.5-tonne (1-tonne fiducial) double-phase TPC optimized for S2-only DM searches

lineage.locator: arXiv:2402.07566, introduction ("Bringing together the experience from previous argon-based detectors")
lineage.note: No source consulted (checked 2026-09-17) names DarkSide-50 specifically as DarkSide-20k's predecessor in so many words; this relation is inferred from the collaboration's own framing of DarkSide-20k as the continuation of "previous argon-based detectors" in the same DarkSide/GADMC programme, which DarkSide-50 is the most direct example of. Confidence is approximate for that reason.

name: DarkSide-20k
notes: Schedule conflict: arXiv:2402.07566 (Feb 2024) says "data taking is expected to start in late 2026"; the LNGS facility page (fetched 2026-09-17) says operations are "expected to begin in 2027". Both are recorded as planned schedules, not treated as a resolved interval bound, to avoid asserting a specific date neither source agrees on precisely.

physics_goals.quote: The main goal of the experiment is to discover or to extend the current sensitivity limits on the search for dark matter WIMP-like particles.
value: Discover or extend current sensitivity limits on WIMP-like dark matter particles using a 50-tonne liquid argon target

summary.plain: DarkSide-20k will be a much bigger dark matter detector, holding fifty tonnes of liquid argon, being built deep under a mountain in Italy. It is the successor of the smaller DarkSide-50 experiment and is still under construction, with data taking expected around 2026-2027.
summary.technical: Dual-phase liquid argon TPC with SiPM light readout, 50 t active mass, under construction in LNGS Hall C as the flagship detector of the Global Argon Dark Matter Collaboration (GADMC). As of the source fetched (arXiv:2402.07566, 2024), the external cryostat was being installed; data taking was expected to start in late 2026. The LNGS facility page (checked 2026-09-17) instead gives 2027 for the start of operations -- a schedule discrepancy noted, not resolved.

unique_capabilities.quote: the community is now building a dual-phase LAr-TPC equipped with SiPM arrays for light readout
value: Large-area cryogenic SiPM light readout arrays (tens of square metres)
